ctx.x: I played with his band a while. And then uh, moved Johnny Censier. He come back from uh, out of Chicago. And then he started. After I left out of there, I started back my own group. And I played my own group up until, well up at the present, I get a little gist when I usually work a lot by myself. You know, entertain guitar and band. I played with them. And sing. When did you switch the guitar? You were playing band, most of the other bands. Well uh, I uh, right after, during the war, uh, John Patterson, Miss…
See, they went to C-Rolls? Yeah. C-Roll, Caliphas?

Yeah, he had a band placed down there and there was two, it was Dublin. Well I stayed with John Patterson, Big Joe and Lil Joe used to be announcers for the radio, you know, over, over, uh, Schumacher's, you used to call it, the Royal Rendezvous, and then they changed the name to Parisian Gardens, later, you know.
